ruling: docs/TIER-3-DECISION-PACKET-2026-08-02.md (D1-D12 + M, Captain-ratified 2026-08-02; D3f confirmed general)

rule:activated-lifegain-scales-with-sacr.definition: An activated ability whose cost includes sacrificing a creature causes its controller to gain life equal to that creature's toughness. Sibling of rule:lifegain-scales-with-sacrificed-creature-toughness, which is the unmarked spell form (grammar section 1: DELIVERY omitted = spell ability, CR 113.3a).
rule:activated-lifegain-scales-with-sacr.note: D3 - Miren, the Moaning Well; delivery split per the D3d Snag/Gossamer Chains precedent

rule:upkeep-trigger-lifegain-scales-with.definition: At the beginning of its controller's upkeep, a triggered ability sacrifices a creature and its controller gains life equal to that creature's toughness. The sacrifice occurs in resolution text, not as a cost (grammar section 9). Sibling of rule:lifegain-scales-with-sacrificed-creature-toughness, the unmarked spell form.
rule:upkeep-trigger-lifegain-scales-with.note: D3 - Doomgape; delivery split per the D3d precedent

rule:attack-trigger-self-pump-scales-wit.definition: An attack-triggered ability gives the attacking source itself a power/toughness boost scaling with the number of ATTACKING creatures its controller controls. Distinct from rule:attack-trigger-pump-scales-with-creature-count: grammar section 7 enumerates attacker-count and creature-count as separate closed stat vocabulary, so the two are different stats, not one parameterized stat.
rule:attack-trigger-self-pump-scales-wit.note: D4 - Akroan Hoplite; section 7 stat split, same class as D3e target-color-count

rule:etb-surveil.definition: When the permanent itself enters the battlefield, its controller surveils a fixed number of cards. Distinct from rule:etb-creature-triggers-surveil, which fires when ANOTHER creature its controller controls enters, and from rule:etb-scry: surveil and scry are different keyword actions (grammar section 4).
rule:etb-surveil.note: D5 - clears the open C2 finding on upkeep-surveil AND the open C3 finding on etb-scry

rule:death-trigger-token-count-scales-wi.definition: When this permanent dies, a triggered ability creates a number of tokens scaling with the number of creature cards in its controller's graveyard. Sibling of rule:token-count-scales-with-graveyard-creature-count, the unmarked spell form, and of rule:death-trigger-token-scales-with-power in the same death-trigger token-scaling family.
rule:death-trigger-token-count-scales-wi.note: D6 - Hallowed Spiritkeeper; delivery split per grammar section 1

rule:activated-tap-exile-graveyard-creat.definition: An activated ability whose cost includes tapping the source and exiling a creature card from a graveyard creates a creature token. The {T} caps the ability at once per turn, which is axis identity under grammar section 2 (D3f), separating it from the uncapped mana-only sibling rule:activated-exile-graveyard-creature-for-token.
rule:activated-tap-exile-graveyard-creat.note: D3f applied general per Captain ruling 2026-08-02; naming follows rule:activated-tap-grants-haste-other-creature-you-control

rule:restricts-opponent-search.definition: Prevents or restricts library searching. The restriction may be symmetric (binding every player, including the controller) or opponent-only; the ownership reading is a facet, not part of this axis's claim.
rule:restricts-opponent-search.why: D7 - the slug claimed opponent scope but 2 of 3 members are symmetric ('Players can't search libraries'). C1b class: member evidence contradicts the name. No new vocabulary: restricts/search were already in the slug, 'library' is Q5-ratified vocabulary

rule:death-of-your-permanents-grows-this.definition: Whenever another permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, this permanent gains a counter and grows. Not restricted to permanents its controller controls: two of three members trigger on any creature dying.
rule:death-of-your-permanents-grows-this.why: D8 - the slug claimed 'your permanents' but Haruspex and Elenda trigger on ANY creature dying. C1b class. Minimal-churn derivation: only the false token 'your' is replaced, by 'other' (Q5-ratified vocabulary, and true of all three members, each of which prints 'another')

moves.why: D3 - Miren, the Moaning Well is '{3}, {T}, Sacrifice a creature:' -- an activated ability on a land, not a spell
D3 - Doomgape is 'At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature' -- an upkeep trigger whose sacrifice is in resolution text
D4 - Akroan Hoplite scales with 'the number of ATTACKING creatures you control' = attacker-count, a separate section 7 stat from creature-count
D5 - Faerie Dreamthief is 'When this creature enters, surveil 1' -- an ETB, not an upkeep trigger. Clears the open C2 drift finding on this axis
D5 - Gallifrey Council Chamber, Lazav the Multifarious and Watcher in the Mist all SURVEIL on their own ETB, not scry. Clears the open C3 drift finding on etb-scry
D6 - Hallowed Spiritkeeper is 'When this creature dies, create X ...' -- a death trigger on an unmarked (spell) slug

D12 - Havengul Runebinder's cost is '{2}{U}, {T}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard:'. The {T} caps it at once per turn; the other two members are uncapped mana-only engines. D3f, confirmed general by Captain 2026-08-02

drops.why: D1 - Mirror of Life Trapping's trigger EVENT is 'Whenever a creature enters'; 'if it was cast' is an intervening-if condition about casting, which grammar section 2 (b6 Village Ironsmith) rules is not a cast trigger. The card never casts from exile. No axis has the other-permanent-ETB shape it needs; ledger-flagged as homeless per D5 remove-and-rehome's third option

D2 - Ria Ivor, Bane of Bladehold's own cited quote is about preventing combat damage and creating Mite tokens; the card's full text mentions neither Equipment nor attaching. Keen Sense class. Closest family (prevent-combat-damage-unblocked-creature) has an unblocked restriction Ria Ivor lacks; ledger-flagged as homeless

rule:alt-win-empty-library.5277a68e-1ceb-4b40-8e10-3d0564f5d7be: If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead.
rule:alt-win-empty-library.aa286dd5-aa19-446d-9003-684d81eb57ca: If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead.
rule:alt-win-empty-library.1de1b591-a73f-4974-b507-8c63e07a0868: If X is greater than or equal to the number of cards in your library, you win the game.

rule:targets-a-player.dbd6a94b-62ff-4a10-9d52-bdd90b26e425: Target player takes an extra turn after this one.

definition_edits.rule:combat-trigger-auto-attach-equipmen: At the beginning of combat on its controller's turn, a triggered ability attaches an Equipment its controller controls to a creature -- the source itself or another creature its controller controls -- without paying the equip cost.
definition_edits.rule:lifegain-scales-with-sacrificed-cre: A spell with an additional cost of sacrificing a creature causes its controller to gain life equal to that creature's toughness. Unmarked delivery = spell ability (grammar section 1, CR 113.3a); the activated and upkeep-triggered forms are separate sibling axes.
definition_edits.rule:attack-trigger-pump-scales-with-cre: An attack-triggered ability grants a power/toughness boost scaling with the number of creatures its controller controls. The boosted creature may be the attacking source itself or another target creature its controller controls -- that object choice is a facet, not part of this axis's claim.
definition_edits.rule:leaves-battlefield-returns-exiled-c: When this permanent leaves the battlefield, a card it had exiled is returned to its owner. The destination follows the zone the card was exiled from -- to its owner's hand in most cases, to the battlefield under its owner's control where a battlefield permanent was exiled -- and is a facet, not part of this axis's claim.
definition_edits.rule:alt-win-empty-library: Wins the game on an empty or effectively-empty library, whether by replacing the draw that would otherwise be lethal ('if you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead') or by an explicit library-size check. Child of rule:alternate-win-condition.
definition_edits.rule:draw-scales-with-creature-count: The spell causes its controller to draw a number of cards equal to a creature count, optionally matching a filter. The count is not restricted to creatures its controller controls -- the slug is deliberately unscoped, and the codebook marks ownership explicitly when it means it (cf. rule:pump-scales-with-own-creature-count, grammar section 6).
